problem_text:
A logistics firm must coordinate the distribution of specialized equipment from ten regional warehouses to ten major construction sites, with the objective of minimizing total delivery expenses.  

The available inventory at each warehouse is as follows:  
*Warehouse W1 has 85 units.  
*Warehouse W2 has 157 units.  
*Warehouse W3 has 76 units.  
*Warehouse W4 has 180 units.  
*Warehouse W5 has 80 units.  
*Warehouse W6 has 122 units.  
*Warehouse W7 has 79 units.  
*Warehouse W8 has 77 units.  
*Warehouse W9 has 177 units.  
*Warehouse W10 has 100 units.  

The required deliveries to each construction site are fixed:  
*Site S1 must receive 117 units.  
*Site S2 must receive 125 units.  
*Site S3 must receive 147 units.  
*Site S4 must receive 54 units.  
*Site S5 must receive 61 units.  
*Site S6 must receive 24 units.  
*Site S7 must receive 82 units.  
*Site S8 must receive 136 units.  
*Site S9 must receive 103 units.  
*Site S10 must receive 72 units.  

The per-unit delivery cost from each warehouse to each site is provided in the table below:  

| From / To | S1 | S2 | S3 | S4 | S5 | S6 | S7 | S8 | S9 | S10 |
|-----------|----|----|----|----|----|----|----|----|----|-----|
| W1  | 8  | 1  | 1  | 3  | 4  | 19 | 16 | 5  | 3  | 17 |
| W2  | 3  | 4  | 9  | 8  | 15 | 10 | 9  | 15 | 2  | 4  |
| W3  | 6  | 2  | 10 | 12 | 11 | 14 | 4  | 4  | 2  | 1  |
| W4  | 5  | 6  | 11 | 12 | 15 | 20 | 9  | 3  | 12 | 11 |
| W5  | 6  | 4  | 13 | 13 | 15 | 9  | 13 | 16 | 14 | 6  |
| W6  | 4  | 5  | 2  | 6  | 4  | 14 | 19 | 16 | 19 | 15 |
| W7  | 6  | 20 | 13 | 12 | 20 | 1  | 5  | 16 | 16 | 4  |
| W8  | 14 | 15 | 2  | 3  | 9  | 11 | 1  | 17 | 19 | 19 |
| W9  | 8  | 11 | 17 | 17 | 20 | 4  | 14 | 8  | 16 | 12 |
| W10 | 13 | 5  | 18 | 20 | 2  | 1  | 6  | 17 | 16 | 16 |

Determine the optimal shipment quantities to achieve the lowest possible total cost.
